decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P-31 LG-01 (Rev A); P-31 LG-03 (Rev A) Received:  07 February 2019 and P-31 LG-02  Received:  20 December 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The approved corner side window facing north west towards no. 29 Lyncroft Gardens must be obscure glazed and permanently retained as such.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows and doors shall be formed in the side elevations of the rear extension.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension.
